notes: Curated download catalog. Sizes are bytes observed in real engine stores/caches (size_source=catalog) or null (unknown). verified=true means the artifact id was seen on a real engine or cache when the seed was built; other ids follow each engine's naming convention and are checked by presence probes and by the post-download verification in model_materializer. upstream={method, checked, revision?} records an id verified to exist upstream on that date (hf_api: HfApi.model_info(files_metadata=True), download_bytes = the weight files; ollama_registry: the registry manifest, download_bytes = the sum of its layers); such an artifact must carry its verified size. options carries route options the recommendation copies (the MTP builds: speculation).
